seoTitle: Quit Smoking Savings Calculator (Money Saved and Milestones)
metaDescription: Show the money saved and cigarettes not smoked since your quit date, plus the health milestones the CDC lists, from cigarettes per day and pack price.
intro: See the money you saved and the health milestones reached since quitting.
why:
Enter your quit date, how many cigarettes you smoked a day, the pack price and pack size. The page counts the cigarettes you did not smoke and the money saved, and marks which health milestones from the CDC list you have reached.

The milestones are measured against continuing to smoke. Savings assume the same price throughout. If you are struggling, a doctor or a national quit line can help.
howTo: Enter cigarettes per day, pack price and pack size.
Leave the end date blank to count to today.
Read the savings and the milestones.

faq.q: Where do the milestones come from?
faq.a: From the CDC page on the benefits of quitting smoking. Time points are ranges there, shown as such.
